On Campus

You can find Herman Brown Hall looking for building #17 at this map (see blue arrow).

The nearest visitor parking is available at the North Annex lot accessible via Entrance #20 (Rice Boulevard). Other parking lots that are available to off-campus visitors are the West Lot (opposite of the Alice Pratt Brown Hall, #15 on the map — entrances 8 or 18) and the Greenbriar lot (west of the Rice Stadium — entrances 13A or 13B). Parking rates differ and for more information, including Accessible Parking, please refer to this link. For the more remote parking facilities, visitors can make use of the free shuttle service. A live tracker is available at this link.
